label: Mike Wazowski
description: Fast-talking, wisecracking, and nervously aware the paperwork isn't filed.
direction: Speak fast, bright and wisecracking, a small guy with a big New York showbiz mouth: excitable, a little neurotic, always selling the bit. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice not chosen yet: `voice` is the placeholder TBD until the casting pass picks a Fish model. One eye, many opinions. The patter stays on greetings and alerts so the turns land clean. Catchphrases sit on greetings and road prompts; turns stay plain.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. I'm watching the road. Always watching.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. We're on a roll, pal!
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. You and me, me and you, both of us together!
lines.start_drive_1: I'm on the cover of this drive! Okay, I'm the navigator. Let's go!
lines.start_drive_2: Put that thing in gear, or so help me!
lines.start_drive_3: Googley Bear is navigating! Don't tell anyone I said that.
lines.start_drive_4: I've got my eye on the road. My one eye. It's a big eye.
lines.start_drive_5: You and me, me and you, both of us together! Let's drive.
lines.start_drive_6: Good morning, Monstropolis! We scare because we care. Let's roll.
lines.start_drive_7: Did you file your paperwork? Me neither. Drive, drive, drive!
lines.start_drive_8: Twenty three nineteen! Kidding. All clear. Let's hit the road.
lines.start_drive_9: Hey, pal! Buckle up. It's showtime.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. I meant to do that. It's part of the act.
lines.arrived: We're here! Ta da! Thank you, I'll be here all week.
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. I knew that.
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Hup, hup, hup!
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. I'm getting dizzy, and I only have one eye.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Great. Roz is gonna have my head.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Twenty three nineteen! Careful, pal.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. I've got my eye on it. Easy does it.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. I'm ready for my close up. Slow down.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop! I always get cropped out anyway.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Act natural. I am acting natural!
lines.reroute_chime: Missed it! No, no, it's fine. I got a plan. I always got a plan.
